calls.title: Design Review: Dimensions & Capping
calls.summary:
# Design Review: Dimensions & Capping
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 46m

## Summary
The discussion covered several product-direction decisions and follow-ups. For dimensions, nested signals were preferred, with a dedicated signals view as the starting point, while slices and multivariations still need treatment. For results, the group considered a smart surface with signals embedded in results, requested a dynamic results mockup, and noted that dynamic configuration needs broader feedback. Pinned breakdowns were kept as separate functionality. For capping, the proposed experience includes an indicator on the metric, a warning badge, and short dynamic labels, with capping ready for implementation; generic language for capping and Cupid was also noted. Follow-up responsibilities include Gabe cleaning the capping handoff and prioritizing the results UI, Luke preparing the Cloud artifact, and verifying drill-down telemetry.

## Keywords
Dimension signals, Results page, Nested tabs, Metric drill-down, Capping warnings, Experiment dashboards
